sentences.en: I often heard him playing the melody on the trumpet.
sentences.zh: 我经常听到他用小号演奏旋律。

sentences.en: This melody is very pleasing to my ears. Please continue.
sentences.zh: 这段旋律听起来很悦耳，请继续弹奏。

sentences.en: My four-year-old son likes composing little melodies on the piano.
sentences.zh: 我的四岁儿子喜欢在钢琴上创作一些简单的曲调。

senses.zh: 旋律，曲调,美妙的音乐，和谐的调子,好听的声音,歌曲
